user.title: Add room
user.description: One entry per room. Set the times in the Heizplan Card afterwards.

data.name: Room
data.off_when_inactive: Turn thermostat off while no plan is active

data_description.climate: The plan switches this thermostat (comfort / eco / frost as preset).
data_description.season_entity: The plan only runs while this switch is on.
data_description.mode_entity: Central selection, e.g. off / heating / vacation.
data_description.mode_heat: Option text for the normal plan, exactly as in the selection.
data_description.mode_vacation: Option text for the vacation plan (empty = no vacation plan).
data_description.workday_entity: Holiday calendar or workday sensor. On holidays (Mon–Fri) the Sunday plan applies.
data_description.off_when_inactive: The thermostat is turned off outside the heating season or while heating mode is off, and turned on again afterwards.
data_description.presence_entity: Selection with the mode of the floor, e.g. normal / vacation / away. Only has an effect while heating is on.
data_description.presence_away: Option text for "nobody home". The vacation/away plan then applies.
data_description.presence_home: Option text for "off work but at home". Mon–Fri then use the Sunday plan. Leave empty if not wanted.

error.climate_in_use: There is already a room for this thermostat.
